title: Baligod, 14 others arrested over ‘unjust vexation’ case

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Lawyer Levito Baligod, counsel for 18 individuals known as the “maleta boys,” and 14 others were arrested in San Juan City on Friday over an “unjust vexation” case, police said. San Juan City Police Chief Police Col. Anthony Gantang confirmed the arrests in a phone interview with reporters. He said the Zambales Regional Trial Court issued the arrest warrant on Sept. 23. Police arrested the individuals in front of the Hall of Justice in San Juan City, Gantang said.
